KeysToEntries.WoM.NotSpokenTo.Intro.1: Aha, a very useful tool you've managed to make for yourself, there. Why, I remember in my, admittedly distant, youth, spending countless hours trying to catch something from a local pond with one. The owners were not happy.
KeysToEntries.WoM.NotSpokenTo.Intro.2: Why, if you can find yourself a nice spot, it can be a relaxing way to wile away the dull daylight hours between adventures -- challenging yourself to find that one, pristine, fish you see mockingly swimming in the waters before you.
KeysToEntries.WoM.NotSpokenTo.Intro.3: Ah, but I haven't eaten a good fish for ages! Hrmm... how about you look around and see if you could find me a sardine in the waters around here. You'll need a Fishing Rod to catch one though! You may want to consider crafting some bait too!
KeysToEntries.WoM.SpokenTo.NoFish: Still looking for fish? I have a few tips that might help.
KeysToEntries.WoM.SpokenTo.HasFish.1: Ah, wonderful, a delicious sardine. It brings back old memories. Now I just need to fry it up, just like old grampa used to. Thank you, adventurer. Here, for your troubles.
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.Nets: Can you tell me about fishing with nets?
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.Bait: Can you tell me about bait?
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.Rods: Can you tell me about rod fishing?
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.WhatDo: What can I do with the fish?
KeysToEntries.WoM.ExtraInfo.Nets.1: It is the simplest thing in the world. Just equip your net in your hands, stand inside of the Net Fishing Spot and start trawling. The small fish are hidden away, among all types of junk, so don't be discouraged.
KeysToEntries.WoM.ExtraInfo.Bait.1: Oh, now those are interesting. You see, each fish has different tastes, and if you have a bait a fish likes equipped while fishing, you get a better chance of catching them.
KeysToEntries.WoM.ExtraInfo.Bait.2: Some fish like eating other, smaller, fish - the sort you can find with your net. Others prefer a moving target, and jingly things like feathers draw their attention.
KeysToEntries.WoM.ExtraInfo.Rods: That’s where it gets interesting. Fish don’t exactly want to be caught, so they will put up a fight! Once one bites, it’ll try to bolt and you'll need to wear it out. Move from side to side to counter the direction it’s swimming in and keep the pressure on.
KeysToEntries.WoM.ExtraInfo.WhatDoWithFishies.1: Boil them, roast them, put them in a stew. You can make all sorts of delicious dishes from all sorts of fishes. Oh and if you find some really nice ones, you can put them on display if you want to show off your angling skills.
KeysToEntries.WoM.OptionalLink: Anything else I can help you with?
KeysToEntries.Quest.Name: Shrimp Catcher
KeysToEntries.Quest.Description: The Wise Old Man has some tips on how to grow as an amateur angler.
KeysToEntries.Objective.SpeakToWiseOldMan: Speak to the Wise Old Man to learn about Fishing.
KeysToEntries.Objective.StartFishing: Fish a Sardine at a fishing spot near the Wise Old Man.
KeysToEntries.Objective.ReturnToWoM: Return to the Wise Old Man.
KeysToEntries.WOM.ExtraInfo.Rods.2: Do it long enough and the fish will become exhausted for a short time, that’s your cue to reel it in! Just keep an eye on your stamina and don’t get sloppy, or you’ll snap the line and watch your prize swim away.
KeysToEntries.WoM.ExtraInfo.Nets.2: The more you practice the easier it will become to catch something. Stronger fish require stronger nets, so remember to upgrade!
